idea-plugin.name: RSM
idea-plugin.description:
Replay State Memory (RSM) integration for JetBrains IDEs.

Bundles a Node 22 sidecar hosting rsm-agent (MCP server). Transport: MCP over stdio only. Backend-only execution (Local, Split Mode, Gateway safe).

0.2.0 adds the RSM Console tool window on the right rail, an auto-provisioned RSM Home, an automatic memory tier, a Source & Context drawer with Auto Feed run-scoped cleanup, and a Trace tab that operationalizes the E2E correlation-id verification criterion. No backend contract changes.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.2.0

  • Right-rail tool window RSM with four tabs: Runtime, Sources, Trace, Settings.
  • Zero-configuration first run: RSM Home auto-provisioned, demo source seeded, sidecar auto-starts.
  • Automatic memory tiering (256/512/1024 MB) based on total physical RAM.
  • Actions now extend AnAction — discoverable in Find Action (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+A).
  • Trace tab captures every MCP call with a matched rsm.callId.
  • Auto Feed toggle: attached sources are auto-cleaned on run boundary.
  • Settings persisted via PersistentStateComponent (RoamingType.DISABLED).
  • No changes to MCP surface, HostError kinds, or the 5-state runtime vocabulary.
